title: Additivity bound for support-restricted subspaces
statement:
Fix a prime $p$ and an integer $n$, and let $S$ be a subspace of the ambient space $V = \mathbb{F}_p^n \times \mathbb{F}_p^n$. For a subset $M \subseteq \{1,\dots,n\}$ with complement $M^c$, write $S_M = S \cap V_M$ and $S_{M^c} = S \cap V_{M^c}$ for the intersections of $S$ with the corresponding support subspaces. Then
\[
  \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} S_M + \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} S_{M^c} \le \dim_{\mathbb{F}_p} S.
\]
hypotheses_covered: S is a subspace of V = F_p^n × F_p^n
M is a subset of the coordinate index set Fin n
M^c is the complement of M
